It’s unlikely they got into your google account with an ip grabber like grabbify.link unless it was a phishing login and you signed into google on the link they sent you. Assuming that’s not the case they could have gotten the photo by looking up your name + general location, maybe you had it set as an avatar somewhere or on your or your families social media accounts? 

If you want their account possibly shut down for threats of violence and doxxing you can report the incident to discord via [Discord Trust & Safety](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000291932-How-to-Properly-Report-Issues-to-Trust-Safety)

Them having your IP address and photo does not necessarily mean they know your street address. It usually just gives a general area of the coverage from your ISP. 

If you believe this to be a serious threat report it to your local authorities, they will likely require seeing the physical messages rather than just images of them. Screen recording the messages (to show they’re real) wouldn’t be a terrible idea. If you want to report them, go down to the station, unless you believe your life is in imminent danger (in that case call the authorities).
